title: Nicolas Cage Declares He’s “Currently Homeless” After Sinkhole Swallows LA Mansion Yard
body:
Nicolas Cage, the Oscar‑winning actor known for his eclectic roles and off‑beat public persona, revealed on Saturday that he is effectively “homeless” after a massive sinkhole opened up beneath his Malibu estate last month. The 62‑year‑old star, who was appearing at Los Angeles Comic‑Con, joked that he has been “sort of living in hotels” while engineers assess the damage and determine whether the sprawling property can be salvaged. The incident has sparked a flurry of speculation about the safety of hillside homes in Southern California and has reignited conversation about the actor’s recent financial woes.

The sinkhole, which appeared in September near the historic mansion that Cage purchased in 2019 for $7.75 million, reportedly measured roughly 30 feet in diameter and was deep enough to cause a noticeable shift in the foundation. Neighbors described hearing a “rumbling” and seeing a sudden depression in the ground that threatened to swallow the structure. Although no one was injured, the incident forced Cage and his family to vacate the property immediately. Since then, the actor has been staying in a series of boutique hotels around Los Angeles, a situation he described with his trademark self‑deprecating humor during a press interview at the convention.

Cage’s revelation arrives amid a broader narrative of his recent fiscal turbulence. Over the past few years, the star has publicly disclosed a string of costly real‑estate purchases and sales, including a $13 million New York loft and a $15 million Beverly Hills home, many of which were later listed at a loss. In 2022, he filed for bankruptcy protection, citing debts exceeding $10 million. While the sinkhole incident does not directly implicate his finances, it underscores the precariousness of maintaining multiple high‑value properties in an area prone to geological instability. Real‑estate experts note that the Los Angeles basin sits atop a complex network of fault lines and underground water tables, making sinkholes a rare but not unheard‑of hazard for hillside residences.

Industry insiders suggest that the damage could be more extensive than initially reported. Structural engineers who have examined the site say that the sinkhole may have compromised the mansion’s load‑bearing walls, plumbing, and electrical systems, potentially requiring a complete foundation rebuild. Such repairs could run into the tens of millions, a figure that may be prohibitive even for a celebrity of Cage’s stature. The actor’s publicist has not confirmed whether insurance will cover the loss, leaving fans to wonder if the “hotel life” could become a longer‑term arrangement.

Beyond the personal ramifications for Cage, the incident has prompted local officials to revisit zoning and building codes for hillside developments. The Los Angeles Department of Building and Safety has announced a review of recent permits granted in the Malibu area, emphasizing the need for more rigorous geotechnical surveys before construction. Environmental groups have also seized on the episode to call for stricter oversight of groundwater extraction, which can exacerbate subsurface erosion and increase sinkhole risk.

Despite the upheaval, Cage remains upbeat, emphasizing his love for the projects that keep him busy. He referenced upcoming film commitments and his ongoing involvement with the “National Treasure” franchise, noting that the experience has given him a fresh perspective on resilience and improvisation—qualities he has long championed in his acting career. Fans on social media have rallied around the actor, flooding his accounts with supportive messages and jokes about his “glamping” lifestyle.

Looking ahead, the next few weeks will be crucial in determining the fate of Cage’s Malibu home. Engineers are expected to deliver a detailed assessment by early next month, after which the actor will decide whether to rebuild, sell, or abandon the property altogether. Regardless of the outcome, the sinkhole saga adds another chapter to Nicolas Cage’s larger-than-life narrative, illustrating how even Hollywood’s most iconic figures can find themselves navigating unexpected challenges in the ever‑shifting landscape of fame and fortune.
